criteria.requirement: Repair Problem.getSolutionsOrderedList: order=None keeps the prior default value order, every explicit variable sequence (including length one and empty) projects exactly those columns and always returns tuples. Reject string/bytes order, duplicate variables and unknown IDs before search. Preserve arbitrary hashable variable identities without sorting/comparing them. getSolutionsAsListDict must operate on the projected rows and retain its existing validate=True duplicate-projection check; do not silently deduplicate full solutions. Deliver source repair, meaningful public failure cases and compatibility documentation.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
